name: Places365-Validation
description: The Places365-Validation set is used to evaluate scene recognition models across 365 indoor/outdoor scene categories. It measures models' ability to correctly classify images into fine-grained scene classes, typically reporting top-1 and top-5 accuracy. The split is commonly used to compare backbone architectures and scene-classification approaches in computer vision.
reputation: Widely used and standard benchmark in scene recognition and computer vision research.
